seasons.theme: The first season, introduced with patch 2.1.0 alongside seasonal leaderboards and season-exclusive legendaries.
seasons.notes: Americas start 6:00 PM PDT Aug 29; end 4:00 PM PST Feb 3 (Blizzard forum schedule, via fandom and press). Regions launched staggered.

seasons.theme: New season-exclusive legendaries, conquests and banner rewards.
seasons.notes: Americas start 6:00 PM PST; end 9:00 PM PDT Apr 5 (Blizzard posts as reported by fandom and press). Shortest season (~7 weeks).

seasons.theme: Launched with patch 2.2.0 with new season-exclusive legendaries and the first seasonal pennant.
seasons.notes: Americas start 6:00 PM PDT (one press report said 10 PM Pacific; Blizzard's forum schedule and other reports say 6 PM). End 5:00 PM PDT.

seasons.theme: Introduced the Season Journey for tracking seasonal progress.
seasons.notes: First season with 5:00 PM start and end times. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.theme: Introduced Haedrig's Gift free class sets and Season Rebirth; first bonus stash tab reward.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).
Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).
Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.theme: First season launched without a new patch; only conquests and rewards rotated.
seasons.notes: No new patch at launch (game was on 2.4.2). Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).
Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.theme: First season available on consoles.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.theme: First season with the Necromancer class from Rise of the Necromancer.
seasons.notes: Started on a Thursday instead of Friday. End 5:00 PM PDT Oct 20 per Blizzard. Start time assumed 5:00 PM PDT from fandom's 5 PM convention; EU started 5:00 PM CEST.
Started Thursday, Nov 9 at 5:00 PM PST. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).
Launched without a new patch. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of Greed
seasons.theme: First themed season: Treasure Goblin spawns were doubled.
seasons.notes: Name per fandom; Blizzard's announcement was titled 'Season 14 First Look: Themed Seasons'. Launch patch not sourced. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Boon of the Horadrim
seasons.theme: Horadric Caches from bounties were doubled.
seasons.notes: Originally scheduled to end Dec 16, 2018; extended to Jan 6, 2019. Launch patch not sourced. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of Grandeur
seasons.theme: All seasonal players gained the Ring of Royal Grandeur legendary power.
seasons.notes: Originally scheduled to end Mar 17, 2019; extended 8 weeks to May 12. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of Nightmares
seasons.theme: Seasonal buff based on Legacy of Nightmares: big damage bonus per equipped Ancient item with no set bonuses active.
seasons.notes: First season with no end date announced up front; Blizzard committed to at least two weeks' notice. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of the Triune
seasons.theme: Triune's Will: hits can spawn circles granting damage, resource-cost or cooldown bonuses.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of Eternal Conflict
seasons.theme: Pandemonium-style killstreak buffs that trigger chaotic battlefield effects.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Season of the Forbidden Archives
seasons.theme: Kanai's Cube's three slots could hold legendary powers of any type (weapon, armor or jewelry).
seasons.notes: Name per fandom; Blizzard's launch post was titled 'Season 20 Now Live'. Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Trials of Tempests
seasons.theme: Characters periodically channel an elemental power that is unleashed into the environment.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Shades of the Nephalem
seasons.theme: Shadows of the Past: activating a shrine or pylon summons a shadow clone of your class; Kanai's Cube gets a fourth slot.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: The Disciples of Sanctuary
seasons.theme: Launched with the follower revamp, which gave followers 14 gear slots and Emanate powers.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Ethereal Memory
seasons.theme: Ethereals: seasonal weapons that roll a random class weapon legendary power and class passive.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: The Lords of Hell
seasons.theme: Soul Shards: socketable powers of the Prime and Lesser Evils, upgraded with Hellforge Embers.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: The Fall of the Nephalem
seasons.theme: Echoing Nightmares: a wave-survival event entered with a seasonal item.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Light's Calling
seasons.theme: Angelic Crucibles: sanctify a legendary item to perfect Ancient stats plus one of three class-specific powers.
seasons.notes: Times per fandom: Season 4 onward starts and ends at 5:00 PM Pacific (Americas).

seasons.name: Rites of Sanctuary
seasons.theme: Introduced the Altar of Rites, a seasonal progression altar unlocked with materials and choices.
seasons.notes: End Sep 10 at 5:00 PM PDT per Blizzard forum notice (Aug 28, 2023). Dexerto reported Aug 20, 2023, which is wrong. Longest D3 season (~28 weeks).

seasons.name: Visions of Enmity
seasons.theme: Visions of Enmity: random portals to high-density monster areas; also introduced Solo Self-Found mode.
seasons.notes: Start 5:00 PM PDT is official. End date (Sunday, Jan 7, 2024) is from BlizzardWatch and fandom; no Blizzard post found. Last season with an original theme.

seasons.name: The Lords of Hell
seasons.theme: Returning Soul Shards theme from Season 25; Altar of Rites and Visions of Enmity became permanent seasonal features.
seasons.notes: Start is official. End Sunday, Apr 7, 2024 at 5 PM Pacific per BlizzardWatch and fandom; d3guides lists Mar 31, 2024. No Blizzard post found for the end. First season to remix past themes.

seasons.name: Season of the Forbidden Archives
seasons.theme: Returning Forbidden Archives theme from Season 20: Kanai's Cube slots accept legendary powers of any type.
seasons.notes: Start 5:00 PM PDT is official. End Jul 7, 2024 per BlizzardWatch and fandom; d3guides lists Jun 30, 2024. No Blizzard post found for the end. Blizzard's season page lists patch 2.7.7 only; no new patch at launch.

seasons.name: Ethereal Memory
seasons.theme: Returning Ethereals theme from Season 24.
seasons.notes: Start 5:00 PM PDT is official. End Oct 20, 2024 per BlizzardWatch, GameWatcher and fandom; d3guides lists Oct 6, 2024. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: Shades of the Nephalem
seasons.theme: Returning Shadows of the Past theme from Season 22: shrine/pylon shadow clones and a fourth Kanai's Cube slot.
seasons.notes: Start Oct 25 at 5:00 PM PDT is official (delayed two weeks to avoid D4's Vessel of Hatred). End Jan 19, 2025 per BlizzardWatch citing Blizzard's Season 34 preview; the season accidentally ended early in early January and was restored. GameWatcher reported Feb 4, 2025; d3guides lists Oct 18, 2024 for the start, contradicting Blizzard. End time 5 PM PST assumed from the usual schedule. Patch 2.7.8 per Icy Veins' PTR preview.

seasons.name: Light's Calling
seasons.theme: Returning Angelic Crucibles theme from Season 27.
seasons.notes: Start Jan 31 at 5:00 PM PST (delayed from Jan 24). End Jun 1 per Blizzard's Season 35 post; no time given. d3guides lists May 4, 2025 for the end, contradicting Blizzard. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: Eternal Conflict
seasons.theme: Returning Season 19 theme: Pandemonium killstreak stacks with battlefield effects at kill milestones.
seasons.notes: Start Jun 6 at 5:00 PM PDT is official. End Sunday, Sep 7, 2025 per BlizzardWatch (13 weeks 2 days); no Blizzard post found. d3guides lists May 16 to Aug 17, 2025, which contradicts Blizzard's start date. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: The Lords of Hell
seasons.theme: Returning Soul Shards theme from Season 25.
seasons.notes: Start Sep 12 at 5:00 PM PDT is official. End Sunday, Nov 30, 2025 per a Blizzard blog post quoted by BlizzardWatch; no time given. d3guides lists Aug 29 for the start, contradicting Blizzard. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: The Forbidden Archives
seasons.theme: Returning Forbidden Archives theme: Kanai's Cube slots accept legendary powers of any type.
seasons.notes: Start Dec 5 at 5:00 PM PST is official. End Sunday, Mar 22, 2026 per BlizzardWatch, which says Blizzard confirmed it; d3guides lists Mar 15, 2026. BlizzardWatch had earlier estimated Mar 1. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: Ethereal Memory
seasons.theme: Returning Ethereals theme from Season 24.
seasons.notes: Start Mar 27 at 5:00 PM PDT is official. End Jun 21, 2026 per BlizzardWatch (ended without prior announcement) and d3guides; Blizzard's page only says 'Has Concluded'. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: Shades of the Nephalem
seasons.theme: Returning Shadows of the Past theme: shrine/pylon shadow clones and a fourth Kanai's Cube slot.
seasons.notes: Start Jun 26 at 5:00 PM PDT and end Sep 27 at 5:00 PM PDT are both from Blizzard. DiabloBytes' next-season page says Jun 20, which is wrong. Launch patch not sourced.

seasons.name: Light's Calling
seasons.theme: Returning Angelic Crucibles theme from Season 27: imbue a legendary with one of three random class-specific powers.
seasons.notes: Current season. Start Oct 2 at 5:00 PM PDT per Blizzard's preview. No end date announced. Launch patch not stated by Blizzard; d3guides cites game data version 2.8.0, but that is not confirmed as the launch patch.
